title: Attack skills
summary: Combo attacks and attack bonuses. Combo attacks can be swapped freely.

sections.note: SP comes from first clears. A skill can be learned once the skill it requires is learned.
rows: Attacks the enemy consecutively with a blade.
Attacks the enemy quickly, then jumps to land a powerful blow. This is a Combo Attack skill.
Hits the enemy consecutively and spins to deal a fatal blow. This is a Combo Attack skill.
Recharges more Beta Energy when an attack hits.
Recharges more Beta Energy when an attack hits. More effective than Beta Energy Recharge I.
Strengthens the last blow of some Combo Attacks. Recharges Burst Energy if the attack hits the target.
When attacking the boss, the Counters provide support fire and deal damage to the boss.
